longDescription: #html-body [data-pb-style=GS7TK27], @media only screen and (max-width: 768px) { }4Cabling Insta Crimp Tool 4Cabling Insta Crimp Plugs. Simplifies twisted pairs termination by allowing the wires to be inserted through the connector and out the front. This feature allows the technician to verify the proper wiring order. The electrical performance of the termination is optimised by pulling the connector down over the cable jacket and seating it tightly in the rear of the connector. By reducing the distance between the wire twists and contacts, performance is optimised! Suitable for use with 4Cabling Insta Crimp CAT5E and CAT6 RJ45 plugs only.FEATURES Crimps and trims any excess wire in a single movement. This saves time and ensures wires are all flush with the end of the connector Ratchet mechanism Consistent termination Crimps 4Cabling Insta Crimp 's Built-in stripper for round cable Built-in cutter Our Insta Crimp tool features a built-in ratchet to ensure that the crimp action is consistent. The parallel crimping action guarantees a quality crimp and the precision hardened pins ensure reliable termination each and every time.INSTRUCTIONS Strip the outer cable sheath approx. 30mm Cut off any separator or nylon string flush with cable sheath being careful not to nick conductors Fan out 8 wires and arrange them in colour code 568A. The 8 wires should be flat and neatly lined up next to one another Insert through crimp tool with any excess wire protruding out the front Insert the plug into the correct position on the crimping tool Squeeze the tool firmly, this will terminate the wires and cut off any excess cable length INSTRUCTIONAL VIDEOWARRANTY1-year limited warranty

name: 0.25m RJ45 CAT5E Ethernet Network Cable | Blue
description: 0.25m RJ45 CAT5E Ethernet Network Cable | Blue
longDescription: The 4Cabling's range of quality category 5E Ethernet Patch Leads are made from 100% Bare Copper. CAT5E cables are designed to be used in mission-critical situations where data integrity is of the utmost importance. CAT5E or Category 5 enhanced ethernet cable has the capability to support up to 1000Mbps (1Gbps). It also reduces the amount of crosstalk between the wires within the cable, resulting in a greater overall transmission speed. 4Cabling stock and sell a wide range of CAT5E ethernet cables in 10 colours and lengths varying from 0.25m up to 10m. If you require longer cables we have CAT6 cables available in up to 50m. CAT6 cables support speeds of up to 10Gbs but are also backward compatible with CAT5E standards. 4Cabling is set to provide the best connection for your telecommunication and data network. name: 0.25m RJ45 CAT6 Ethernet Network Cable | Blue
description: 0.25m RJ45 CAT6 Ethernet Network Cable | Blue
longDescription: The 4Cabling CAT6 Patch Ethernet Cables allow for better signal to noise ratio with minimal loss - which translates to faster and more reliable networks for today's applications, CAT6 cable is commonly used where performance, reliability, and maximum speed are needed. Category 6 cable, commonly referred to as CAT6, is a cable standard for Gigabit Ethernet and other network protocols that are backward compatible with the Category 5/5E and Category 3 cable standards. Compared with CAT5 and CAT5E, CAT6 ethernet cable features more stringent specifications for crosstalk and system noise. The cable standard provides performance of up to 250MHz and is suitable for 10BASE-T, 100BASE-TX (Fast Ethernet), 1000BASE-T / 1000BASE-TX (Gigabit Ethernet) and 10GBASE-T (10-Gigabit Ethernet).FEATURES CAT6 stranded Cable: Best used for patch leads Impedance Matched: Wire and connectors are carefully matched to virtually eliminate echoing and cancellation, providing high speed, error free transmission Gold Plated Contacts: Gold plating eliminates corrosion and provides maximum conductivity to ensure data integrity Unique PVC Jacket: Exclusive polymer technology provides unsurpassed durability and flexibility Snag Free Boots: Prevent cable kinks and bent pins when removing them from patch panels Strain Relief: Increases strength while sustaining maximum flexibility even under extreme conditions SPECIFICATIONS Cable Type: CAT6 Connectors: RJ45-RJ45 Length: 0.25m Colour: Blue Jacket Material: PVC Diameter: 6.2mm CERTIFICATIONS UL listed EIA/TIA and RCM approved ISO/IEC11801:2011(Ed. 2.2) ANSI/TIA/EIA-568-C.2 EN 50173-1:2011 EN 50173-2:2007 including amendment A1:2010 IEC61935-2:2010(Ed.3.0) (transmission requirements) HOW TO DISTINGUISH A CAT6 PLUG FROM A CAT5 OR CAT5E PLUGTo distinguish a CAT6 plug from a CAT5 or a CAT5E plug, just simply look at the way the cable wires have been terminated at the end of the plug: A CAT5 or a CAT5E plug will always have all eight wires in a single row The majority of CAT6 plugs will have wires in two rows with four wires per row Some CAT6 plugs will have wires in two rows with 6 wires in the top row and 2 wires in the bottom row WARRANTY3-years limited warranty

longDescription: The 4Cabling CAT6 Patch Ethernet Cables allow for better signal to noise ratio with minimal loss - which translates to faster and more reliable networks for today's applications, CAT6 cable is commonly used where performance, reliability, and maximum speed are needed. Category 6 cable, commonly referred to as CAT6, is a cable standard for Gigabit Ethernet and other network protocols that are backward compatible with the Category 5/5E and Category 3 cable standards. Compared with CAT5 and CAT5E, CAT6 ethernet cable features more stringent specifications for crosstalk and system noise. The cable standard provides performance of up to 250MHz and is suitable for 10BASE-T, 100BASE-TX (Fast Ethernet), 1000BASE-T / 1000BASE-TX (Gigabit Ethernet) and 10GBASE-T (10-Gigabit Ethernet).FEATURES CAT6 Stranded Cable: Best used for patch leads Impedance Matched: Wire and connectors are carefully matched to virtually eliminate echoing and cancellation, providing high speed, error free transmission Gold Plated Contacts: Gold plating eliminates corrosion and provides maximum conductivity to ensure data integrity Unique PVC Jacket: Exclusive polymer technology provides unsurpassed durability and flexibility Snag Free Boots: Prevent cable kinks and bent pins when removing them from patch panels Strain Relief: Increases strength while sustaining maximum flexibility even under extreme conditions SPECIFICATIONS Cable Type: CAT6 Connectors: RJ45-RJ45 Length: 5m Colour: Blue Jacket Material: PVC Diameter: 6.2mm CERTIFICATIONS UL listed EIA/TIA and RCM approved ISO/IEC11801:2011(Ed. 2.2) ANSI/TIA/EIA-568-C.2 EN 50173-1:2011 EN 50173-2:2007 including amendment A1:2010 IEC61935-2:2010(Ed.3.0) (transmission requirements) HOW TO DISTINGUISH A CAT6 PLUG FROM A CAT5 OR CAT5E PLUGTo distinguish a CAT6 plug from a CAT5 or a CAT5E plug, just simply look at the way the cable wires have been terminated at the end of the plug: A CAT5 or a CAT5E plug will always have all eight wires in a single row The majority of CAT6 plugs will have wires in two rows with four wires per row Some CAT6 plugs will have wires in two rows with 6 wires in the top row and 2 wires in the bottom row WARRANTY3-years limited warranty

Category 6 cable, commonly referred to as Cat-6, is a cable standard for Gigabit Ethernet and other network protocols that are backward compatible with the Category 5/5e and Category 3 cable standards.& Compared with Cat-5 and Cat-5e, Cat-6 ethernet cable features more stringent specifications for crosstalk and system noise. The cable standard provides performance of up to 250 MHz and is suitable for 10BASE-T, 100BASE-TX (Fast Ethernet), 1000BASE-T / 1000BASE-TX (Gigabit Ethernet) and 10GBASE-T (10-Gigabit Ethernet). name: 0.25m CAT6A S/FTP LSZH Ethernet Network Cable | Blue
description: 0.25m CAT6A S/FTP LSZH Ethernet Network Cable | Blue
longDescription: The 0.25m CAT6A S/FTP LSZH Ethernet Network Cable in blue is a high-performance solution designed for mission-critical data environments. Engineered with 100% bare copper, these patch leads ensure superior data integrity and maximum transfer speeds, making them ideal for high-density data centres and enterprise networking. The S/FTP shielding provides excellent protection against electromagnetic interference, ensuring a stable connection in complex installations. Built for versatility, this cable is suitable for both shielded and unshielded sites, featuring 8multi-strand conductors in a 4 twisted-pair T568A colour-coded configuration. The fitted 50µm Category 6A compliant 2-row staggered pin plugs guarantee a secure and reliable interface for your hardware. These cables are specifically designed to support high-power PoE applications up to 100W, providing efficient power delivery alongside high-speed data. Safety and durability are at the forefront of the design, featuring a Low Smoke Zero Halogen (LSZH) jacket that reduces the emission of corrosive and toxic gases during combustion. The snag-free, low-profile flush moulded boots prevent cable kinks and protect the RJ45 connectors and pins during installation or removal from crowded patch panels. This robust construction ensures long-term reliability in any professional infrastructure. Fully compliant with international standards including ISO/IEC11801 and ANSI/TIA/EIA-568-C.2, this cable performs at 500MHz to meet the demands of modern 10Gbps networking. The ETL and UL verifications provide peace of mind regarding quality and performance consistency. Whether upgrading a server room or setting up a new office, these 4Cabling patch leads offer the professional-grade quality required for seamless connectivity. FEATURES 100% bare copper Ethernet cable for superior conductivity S/FTP shielding for maximum interference protection Supports high-power PoE applications up to 100W Low Smoke Zero Halogen (LSZH) jacket for enhanced safety Snag-free, low-profile flush moulded boots for easy handling Performance tested up to 500MHz SPECIFICATIONS Cable Type: CAT6A S/FTP Connectors: RJ45-RJ45 Length: 0.25m Colour: Blue Jacket Material: LSZH Diameter: 6.2mm Performance: 500MHz Fitted Plug: 50µm Category 6A 2-row staggered pin Conductors: 8multi-strand, 4 twisted-pair T568A configuration Certifications: ETL Verified, UL Verified, ISO/IEC11801:2011, ANSI/TIA/EIA-568-C.2, EN 50173-1, IEC61935-2 WARRANTY 3-Year Limited Warranty

The housing is made from durable, transparent Polycarbonate rated to UL94V-0 or UL94V-2 standards. These versatile connectors are compatible with both solid and stranded wire from 22AWG to 26AWG. name: USB 3.1 Type C Male to USB 3.0 A Female Adapter (USB-C)
description: USB 3.1 Type C Male to USB 3.0 A Female Adapter (USB-C)
longDescription: This USB 3.1 Type C Male to USB 3.0 A Female Adapter allows you connect standard USB cables and devices to a USB 3.1 Type-C equipped computer. This backwards compatibility to older USB standards will be the main role of USB Type C cables, meaning this adapter which allows your legacy USB 3.0, USB 2.0 and even USB 1.1 devices to join the 3.1 revolution. WHAT IS USB TYPE C or USB-C? Put simply - it's the compact, reversible port that does everything! The USB-C or Type-C connectors connect to both hosts and devices, replacing various Type-B and Type-A connectors and cables with a standard future-proof technology, whilst giving you the very latest in data, AV and power transfer performance. It was as a response to EU regulations calling for a standard connector that the USB Type C was created. USB-C is the absolute latest in high speed connectors, with giants of the consumer electronics community such as Apple, Microsoft and Google quickly adopting this new technology. USB-C, with its SuperSpeed+ will soon replace previous USB types, including USB-A, USB-B and USB Mini-B, making newer devices even thinner & lighter than they are today. The truly practical offering for the USB Type C is its reversible connector - meaning there is no up or down orientation - it works regardless of the way it is plugged in. It is also REALLY fast, with a data transference rate of up to 10Gbps (gigabits per second), so the latest Star Wars: The Force Awakens can be downloaded in its entirety - in high definition - in just 30 seconds. That's up to 20 times faster than USB2.0. And with up to 100 watts of power, USB-C cables can power everything from laptops to large high resolution monitors. USB Type C cables with all of its SuperSpeed, universal appeal and trouble-free, jumble-free use, can be applied to an array of devices. With so much potential, the USB-C has existing USB cables beaten hands down - it'll be around for much longer. Port Priority Function *Priority (port 1 > port 2 > port 3 > port 4 > port 5 > port 6 > port F > port 8): This function helps protect the system if the power becomes overloaded. For example, if port 1, 2, 4 and 7 are using 30W (maximum power per port is 30W, the system power is 120W in total), and there is an additional device inserted into Port 3 at 25W, the system will cut off the power of Port 7 in response to the power exceeding the 120W limit., This means Port 1, 2 and 4 will use 30W, and Port 3 will use 25W, with no power will be supplied to Port 7 as it has the lowest designated priority among the ports in use. Power down Idle Ports When a computer or network equipment is off, the corresponding port of a traditional switch will continue to consume considerable amounts of power. The TL-SG108E can automatically detect the link status of each port and reduce the power consumption of ports that are idle. Power Budget According to Cable Length Ideally, shorter cables would use less power with less power degradation over their length; this is not the case with most devices as they will use the same amount of power across the cable regardless of whether it is 10 or 50 meters in length. The TL-SG108E analyzes the length of the Ethernet cable connected and adjusts the power usage accordingly, rather than keeping the power consumption in a conventional solution. longDescription: TP-Link TL-SF1008P: PoE Switch 8-port 10/100M, 4 ports POE Highlights: With four PoE ports, transfers data and power on one single cable Working with IEEE 802.3af compliant PDs, expands home and office network Requires no configuration and installation Warranty 3-years What This Product Does The TL-SF1008P 8-port 10/100M Desktop PoE Switch provides the seamless network connection. It integrates 100Mbps Fast Ethernet and 10Mbps Ethernet network capabilities. How This Product Works 4 of the 8 Auto-Negotiation RJ45 ports (port-1 to port-4) of the switch support Power over Ethernet (PoE) function. These PoE ports can automatically detect and supply power with those IEEE 802.3af compliant Powered Devices (PDs). In this situation, the electrical power is transmitted along with data in one single cable allowing you to expand your network where there are no power lines or outlets, where you wish to fix devices such as APs, IP Cameras or IP Phones, etc. Overload Arrangement TL-SF1008P has the priority* function which will help protect the system when the system power is overloaded. If all PoE PDs power consumption is >= 53W, a priority will be arranged among the PoE ports, then the system will cut off the power of the lowest-priority port. Port Priority Function *Priority (port-1>port-2>port-3>port-4): This function will help protect the system if the system power becomes overloaded. For example, Port 1, 2 and 4 are using 15.4w (maximum power per port is 15.4W), the system power is 46.2w in total (PoE max LED is red ). If there is an additional PD inserted to Port 3 with 10w then the system will cut off Port 4 to protect the system, this means Port 1, 2 will use 15.4w, and Port3 will use 10w, and no power will be supplied to Port 4. Easy To Use TL-SF1008P is easy to install and use. It requires no configuration and installation. longDescription: TP-Link TL-SF1005P 5-Port 10/100Mbps Desktop Switch with 4-Port PoE TL-SF1005P is a 5 10/100Mbps ports unmanaged switch that requires no configuration and provides 4 PoE (Power over Ethernet) ports. Overload Arrangement, TL-SF1005P has the priority function which will help protect the system when the system power is overloaded. If all PoE PDs power consumption is >= 58W, a priority will be arranged among the PoE ports, then the system will cut off the power of the lowest-priority port. Port Priority Function, Priority (port-1=port-2=port-3>port-4): This function will help to ensure the normal operation of the system, it means Port 4 will be cut off when all total PoE PDs power consumption exceeds 58W. For an example, Port 1, 2 and 4 are using 15.4W (maximum power for per port is 15.4W); the system power is 46.2W in total. If there is an additional PD inserted to Port 3 with 12W, and then the system will cut off the power of Port 4 because of the overloaded power, this means Port 1, 2 will use 15.4W, and Port3 will use 12W, no power will be supplied to Port 4. description: HDMI® Extender, 4K@ 30Hz Support, IR Repeat with HDMI Loop Through
longDescription: This high-performance HDMI network extender transmits professional-grade 4K AV signals up to 70m using Cat6 or higher cabling. By overcoming standard HDMI distance limitations, it provides a stable and cost-effective solution for large-scale AV projects. It is an ideal choice for remote monitoring of PCs and servers, particularly in traffic control centres, medical institutions, and corporate conference systems. The unit features zero-latency transmission, ensuring real-time performance for video editing, gaming, and live monitoring applications. It automatically adjusts parameters to match different network cables, achieving the best possible display performance without manual tuning. The inclusion of a 3.5mm L/R audio jack allows for easy connection of headsets or external speakers at the receiver end. Equipped with an HDMI loop out on the transmitter, this device allows for a local display to be connected simultaneously with the remote unit. The integrated IR passback functionality enables seamless control of your source device from the receiver side. Built-in lightning, surge, and ESD protection ensure long-term reliability and hardware safety in various environments. IMPORTANT INSTALLATION NOTES Power Requirement: This system requires a power supply at both the Transmitter and Receiver ends. Ensure power outlets are available at both locations. Wiring Standard (Solid Cable): For UTP solid core cabling, T568B termination is mandatory. If using S/FTP shielded solid cable, either T568A or T568B is acceptable. For maximum signal stability: and 4K performance approaching the max rated distance, we strongly recommend using Cat6A Shielded Patch Cords (004.100.xxxx) or SLD.C6ASFTP.XXX . For shorter distances, SLD.C6UTP.XXXX or SLD.C6AUUTP.XXX terminated to T568B is suitable. It effectively eliminates the need to coil excess cable, preventing dangerous clutter and maintaining a sterile workspace. Backed by a comprehensive 3-year warranty, this power cord is a trusted solution for maintaining safety standards in healthcare settings. description: High-Quality Fibre Optic Stripper 3 Hole Strip | Diameter: 250 micron, 600-900 micron, 1.6 mm-3.0 mm
longDescription: Fibre Optic Stripper 3 Hole Strip: Efficient Stripping for Precise Fiber ProcessingOur Fibre Optic Stripper 3 Hole Strip is a must-have tool for anyone working with fiber optics. Its three-hole design is specifically engineered to handle different stripping functions with ease. The first hole expertly removes the fiber jacket to the micron buffer coating, ensuring a seamless transition. The second hole is dedicated to stripping the micro buffer coating to the micron cable, enabling precise fiber preparation. Finally, the third hole flawlessly strips the micron cable to the glass fiber without causing any nicks or scratches, resulting in high-quality fiber connections. We understand the importance of accuracy and safety in fiber optic work. That's why our stripper features an angled jaw that guides the fiber into the third hole, reducing the risk of accidental fiber cutting. Additionally, a safety lock mechanism allows for easy storage when the tool is not in use, ensuring a clutter-free workspace and preventing damage. When it comes to durability, our Fibre Optic Stripper 3 Hole Strip stands out. Crafted from strong high carbon steel, it can withstand the demands of frequent use and maintain its functionality over time. The handle is made of TPR (thermoplastic rubber), providing not only excellent grip but also enhanced comfort during extended stripping sessions. With its specific specifications, our stripper offers precise and consistent results. The buffer coating range of 600-900 micron ensures efficient stripping of various cable types. The strip diameter capability ranges from 250 micron coating to expose the 125 micron glass fiber, accommodating a wide range of fiber sizes. Whether you're working with cables ranging from 1.6 mm to 3.0 mm in diameter, our stripper has got you covered. Purchase our Fibre Optic Stripper 3 Hole Strip now and experience hassle-free and accurate fiber optic stripping. Invest in a reliable tool for professional results!FEATURES First hole strips the fiber jacket to the micron buffer coating Second hole then strips the micro buffer coating to the micron cable Third hole strips the micron cable to the glass fiber without nicks or scratches Angled jaw guides fiber into the 3rd hole to prevent accidental cutting of the fiber Safety lock allows the tool to be easily stored when not in use Tool is made of strong high carbon steel and handle is made of TPR (thermoplastic rubber) for high durability and greatercomfort SPECIFICATIONS Buffer Coating: 600-900 micron Strip Diameter: 250 micron coating to expose the 125 micron glass fiber Fiber Jacket: 1.6 mm-3.0 mm WARRANTY1-year limited warranty

longDescription: Field Assembly Fibre Optical Singlemode Connector | SC Connector | Bag of 6 Field assembly connector or fast connector is an innovative field installable optical fibre connector designed for simple and fast field termination of single fibers. Each pigtail is designed for durability and long-term stability, with a wide operating temperature range of -20 to 70°C, ensuring consistent performance in diverse environmental conditions. name: 1.5m SC-SC Flexi Boot OM4 Multimode Fibre Optic Duplex Patch Leads
description: 1.5m SC-SC Flexi Boot OM4 Multimode Fibre Optic Duplex Patch Leads
longDescription: 1.5m SC-SC OM4 Multimode Flexi Boot Fibre Optic Cable Aqua 4Cabling range of Flexi-Boot Fibre optic cables offers a unique approach to cable management. These specialised boots are designed to bend from closer to the connector and stay in the bent position by way of a specialised wire. This ingenious boot is used to keep fibre patch leads clean and organised and set back from rack doors and other external factors that can tap on a fibre lead until its ultimate destruction. Optical fibre cables are the thin, flexible fibres of glass that carry telephone conversations and emails all over the world in a matter of seconds with much less interference than copper cables. Fibre-Optic cables need less amplification to boost signals so they travel better over longer distances. 4Cabling's OM4 Flexi Boot Multimode Fibre Optic Patch Leads provide the connection for high speed and legacy networks like Gigabit Ethernet, Fast Ethernet and Ethernet and is immune to EMI/RFI. They are mainly used on patch panels for the connection between outlets and terminal equipment. The multimode optical fibre cables are manufactured using LSZH cables which conform to IEC, EIA TIA and Telcordia standards. 2mm OVERSLEEVING. WARRANTY 3 YEARS. UPC (Ultra Physical Contact) Connector Applications include: Termination enclosure to equipment patching Equipment to equipment patching Cross-connect patching FEATURES OM4 fibre patch leads conform to ISO/IEC 11801 & to ITU-T G.651.1, TIA/EIA 492AAAC and 492AAAD Ultra Flexible with internal wire to set & forget the bend radius of installed patch leads Individually labelled for lead tracing Low smoke zero halogen (LSZH) cable UPC (Ultra Physical Contact) connector Manufactured with stringent quality control All leads are supplied with a factory test report All ends are polished and individually inspected for correct polishing Supports high speed multi-channel data, voice & video applications Duplex - Aqua jacket zip cord multi-mode 50μ / 125μ UL approved fibre optic cables Conforms to ISO/ IEC 11801 FIBRE SPECIFICATIONS OM4 Multimode Fibre Termination: SC Flexi Boot - SC Flexi Boot Length : 1.5m Colour : Aqua Oversleeving : 2mm Why 4Cabling? name: Optical Fibre Warning Tape
description: Optical Fibre Warning Tape
longDescription: Optical Fibre Warning Tape This black on yellow plastic identification/caution label is used to provide a permanent indication that here runs an important optical fibre cable that should not be disturbed. The label draws attention to “third parties” that there is an important cable. It is used in manholes and pits along the cables route in a dry position in the external/outdoor/field environment. The adhesive-backed label is wrapped typically twice around the cable. Individual label turns are strategically positioned in manholes and pits along the cables route, to identify individual optical fibre cables. The caution label is positioned in a prominent location in the manhole or pit to identify the cable/s. The label should prevent unnecessary disturbance to or movement of an installed optical fibre cable.FEATURES Provides a permanent, easy to read indication that here is an important optical fibre cable Used in manholes and pits along the cables route in the external/outdoor/field environment Aids in cable identification for route tracing, fault finding or cable cut-overs Ensures the Telco uses and maintains quality standards and records Two turns attach directly to an installed and dry optical fibre cable Usually installed on the cable above the high water mark in the pit or manhole SPECIFICATIONS Diametres: 75mm ID/110mm OD Dimensions: 50mm Wide x 66 meters long, Amount of Labels: Approximately 1500 - 2000 Weight: 248g Materials: Plastic and Adhesive Colour: Yellow and Black WARRANTY1-year limited warranty

name: RackStuds Series II | 100 Pack Purple
description: RackStuds Series II | 100 Pack Purple
longDescription: RackStuds Series II | 100 Pack Purple Say goodbye to cage nuts and hello to the faster, easier way to mount your equipment in 19" racks. The revolutionary new Series II Rackstuds are a universal replacement for the common cage nut. If you use cage nuts to mount IT, Pro A/V, Security or Telecommunications equipment in 19" racks, you're going to love Rackstuds. Suitable for most* 19" racks with square punched vertical rails, Rackstuds go in from the front and provide you with a place to hang your equipment while spinning on the lock nut. This makes mounting even heavy equipment much easier, even if you're on your own. They are easier, faster and safer than cage nuts and very strong. description: 1m DisplayPort v1.4 Cable Male to Male | 8K @60Hz Black
longDescription: 4Cabling 1m DisplayPort v1.4 Cable Male to Male | 8K @60Hz Black The DisplayPort cable is the new world standard for connecting audio and visual devices such as Laptops and PCs to a TV or Monitor. Video Electronics Standards Association (VESA) aims to simplify and standardise video connections, and DisplayPort cables are the first step towards this universal update. DisplayPort cables carry both audio and video signal however the audio signal transfer is dependent upon the connecting devices. 4Cabling's DisplayPort 1.4 cables which offer increased bandwidth to 32.4 Gbps and therefore enabling simultaneous use of two 4K Ultra HD monitors. Also supports 3D, HDCP 2.2, HDCP 1.4, 32 sound channel and 1536kHz sample rate. The 4Cabling DisplayPort 1.4 cable enables the connection of your DisplayPort supported (Gaming) PC or Laptop to an Ultra HD High-Resolution Monitor or other Mini DisplayPort supported device. DisplayPort 1.4 adds support for Display Stream Compression 1.2 (DSC), Forward Error Correction, and extends the maximum number of inline audio channels to 32. They are also compatible with the use of adapters with existing standards such as VGA, DVI and HDMI.FEATURES RoHS compliant Forward error correction. HDR metadata transport. Expanded audio transport: 32 audio channels, 1536kHz sample rate, and the inclusion of all known audio formats. Support DSC (Display Stream Compression) 1.2 SPECIFICATIONS Supported resolution: up to 8K @60Hz (7680px x 4320px) Connector A: DisplayPort (Male) Connector B: DisplayPort (Male) Gold plated connectors Length: 1m Colour: Black WARRANTY3-years limited warranty

Fibre Network cables are the thin, flexible fibres of glass that carry data, telephone conversations and emails at high speed all over the world in a matter of seconds with much less interference than copper patch lead. longDescription: The Alta Labs AP6-W is a high-performance, 4-stream wall-mount enterprise access point designed for seamless integration into hospitality, multi-dwelling units (MDUs), and commercial spaces. Its sleek and compact design ensures it blends into any environment. Featuring the latest WiFi 6 technology, the AP6-W delivers superior range and performance, supporting over 250 concurrent clients and a combined throughput rate of up to 3.0Gbps, ensuring reliable connectivity for all users. Powering the AP6-W is incredibly flexible, with multi-direction PoE+ input on both the back and bottom ports, allowing for versatile installation options. It also features a PoE passthrough port to power an additional device, reducing cable clutter. For non-PoE environments, the unit can be powered by an optional 12VDC adapter. Management is streamlined through the scalable, cloud-based interface and mobile app, allowing for on-the-fly changes, real-time status monitoring, and easy multi-site management without needing a reboot. Each password can be assigned unique parameters, such as different VLANs, rate limits, or bypass rules for hotspot and content filters. This provides unparalleled control over network access for guests, IoT devices, and internal users, making it a truly versatile solution for complex network environments. name: Alta Labs | AP7 Pro Enterprise Access Point, WiFi 7 benefits, 4x4, Cloud Managed (PoE+ injector is not included AL-INJECTOR-POE)
description: Alta Labs | AP7 Pro Enterprise Access Point, WiFi 7 benefits, 4x4, Cloud Managed (PoE+ injector is not included AL-INJECTOR-POE)
longDescription: The Alta Labs AP7-Pro Tri-Band WiFi 7 Access Point delivers next-level wireless performance for demanding corporate, commercial, and residential environments. Housed in a sleek, elegant enclosure, it combines robust enterprise features with effortless cloud-based management. Built around a high-performance 10Gbps Ethernet port, this access point ensures wired throughput never bottlenecks your ultra-fast wireless network. Equipped with Tri-Band technology, the access point features a 4x4 MIMO radio on the 5GHz band alongside 2x2 MIMO radios on the 2.4GHz and 6GHz bands. It delivers maximum wireless throughput speeds of up to 649Mbps on 2.4GHz and up to 5.8Gbps on both 5GHz and 6GHz bands, bringing total combined throughput up to 12.25Gbps. Designed to handle over 500 concurrent clients, it features high-density 4096-QAM modulation, Zero Wait DFS, and 802.11r/k/v seamless roaming. name: Arista compatible (QSFP-100G-SRBD) 100G BiDI QSFP28 850nm up to 100M for MMF with LC connectors and DOM
description: Arista compatible (QSFP-100G-SRBD) 100G BiDI QSFP28 850nm up to 100M for MMF with LC connectors and DOM
longDescription: This product can support 100Gb/s bit rates. It is Parallel Quad Small Form-factor Pluggable (QSFP28) Bi-Directional optical module. The module integrates four oust electrical data into two optical lanes (by Dual Wavelength VCSEL Bi-Directional Optical Interface, 850nm, and +900nm) to allow optical communication over a 2-fibre duplex LC optical multi-mode fibre. Reversely, on the receiver side, the module de-multiplexes 2 sets of optical input signals and converts them to 4 channels of electrical data. An optical fibre ribbon cable with LC connector can be plugged into the QSFP28 module receptacle. Proper alignment is ensured by the guide pins inside the receptacle. The cable usually cannot be twisted for proper channel-to-channel alignment. An electrical connection is achieved through an MSA-compliant 38-pin edge-type connector. The module operates by a single +3.3V power supply, LVCMOS/LVTTL global control signals, such as Module Present, Reset, Interrupt, and Low Power Mode, are available with the modules. A 2-wire serial interface is available to send and receive more complex control signals, and to receive digital diagnostic information. Individual channels can be addressed and unused channels can be shut down for maximum design flexibility. The product is designed with form factor, optical/electrical connection, and digital diagnostic interface according to the QSFP28 Multi-Source Agreement (MSA). It has been designed to meet the harshest external operating conditions including temperature, humidity, and EMI. The Module offers very high functionality and feature integration, accessible via a two-wire serial interface. FEATURES QSFP28 MSA Compliant Supports 100GE Aggregated bit rates Supports KP4 FEC @ 100G data rate Two independent full-duplex channels Up to 100m OM4 MMF transmission Single 3.3V power supply Maximum power consumption 4w LC optical connector RoHS-6 compliant Case operating temperature: 0°C to 70°C APPLICATIONS Data Center Interconnect 100G Ethernet Infiniband HDR WARRANTY1-years limited warrantyTAA-approved SFPs available upon request, Contact us for more details.

longDescription: Achieve high-speed, long-distance network links with exceptional efficiency using the Plusoptic 10G Bi-Directional SFP+ transceiver. This powerful module is engineered to transmit and receive data over a single strand of single-mode fibre, effectively halving your fibre cabling requirements and costs. It's the perfect solution for service providers, enterprises, and data centres looking to expand their network reach or upgrade existing infrastructure without the expense of laying new fibre. Designed for superior performance, this transceiver delivers a stable 10Gbps connection over an impressive distance of up to 80km. It operates using distinct wavelengths for sending (1550nm) and receiving (1490nm) data, ensuring clear, interference-free communication. The inclusion of a Digital Diagnostics Monitoring Interface (DDMI) provides network administrators with real-time insights into the module's performance, including temperature, laser power, and signal strength, allowing for proactive maintenance and enhanced reliability. The hot-pluggable SFP+ form factor allows for seamless installation and replacement without needing to power down your network equipment, ensuring maximum uptime. Built to be MSA (Multi-Source Agreement) compliant, this transceiver guarantees broad compatibility with a wide range of switches, routers, and other networking devices from major manufacturers. Combined with a robust construction, the Plusoptic transceiver is a reliable and future-proof investment for your network. name: PlusOptic 1.25G, BiDi SFP, TX1490nm / RX1310nm, 20KM Transceiver, LC Connector for SMF with DOM. BISFP-D-20-PLU | TAA Compliant
description: PlusOptic 1.25G, BiDi SFP, TX1490nm / RX1310nm, 20KM Transceiver, LC Connector for SMF with DOM. BISFP-D-20-PLU | TAA Compliant
longDescription: The PlusOptic TAA Compliant 1.25G BiDi SFP Transceiver is a high-performance, cost-effective solution for extending your Gigabit Ethernet network over long distances. TAA compliance makes this transceiver specifically suitable for government and federal agencies, ensuring procurement adheres to the Trade Agreements Act (TAA). By utilising Bi-Directional (BiDi) technology, this SFP requires only a single strand of single-mode fibre (SMF) to transmit and receive data, effectively doubling your fibre capacity and significantly reducing cabling costs. This module supports data links up to 1.25Gb/s and achieves a reliable reach of 20KM by operating at two distinct wavelengths: 1490nm (Transmit) and 1310nm (Receive). The use of high-quality DFB (Distributed Feedback) laser and PIN photo-detector components ensures superior signal integrity and dependable performance for your core network infrastructure. Its hot-pluggable Small Form Factor Pluggable (SFP) footprint allows for seamless installation or replacement without needing to power down the host device, simplifying maintenance and upgrades. The transceiver is fully compliant with the Multi-Sourcing Agreement (MSA) and SFF-8472 standards, providing broad compatibility with a vast range of switches, routers, and other networking equipment from major vendors. It features a Digital Diagnostic Monitoring (DOM) interface, which allows for real-time monitoring of critical operating parameters, including temperature, voltage, and optical power, enabling proactive network management and diagnostics. Designed for reliable operation within the commercial temperature range of 0°C to +70°C, this module is a robust and flexible choice for modern Gigabit network deployments. The durable metal enclosure effectively reduces electromagnetic interference (EMI), ensuring clean data transmission. With the added benefit of TAA compliance, this PlusOptic SFP is the professional-grade choice for government, enterprise, and education sectors requiring secure, long-distance, single-fibre connectivity. FEATURES TAA Compliant for government and federal agency procurement Bi-Directional (BiDi) operation over a single strand of Single-Mode Fibre (SMF) Supports up to 1.25Gb/s data rates Maximum transmission distance of 20KM TX1490nm/RX1310nm wavelengths for efficient data transfer High-performance DFB laser and PIN photo-detector Hot-pluggable SFP footprint Supports Digital Diagnostic Monitoring (DOM) for real-time diagnostics Low power dissipation RoHS compliant and lead-free SPECIFICATIONS Part Number (Standard): BISFP-D-20-PLU Compliance: TAA Compliant, MSA Compliant, SFF-8472 Compliant, RoHS Compliant Device Type: BiDi SFP Transceiver Data Rate: Up to 1.25Gb/s Transmission Mode: Single-Mode Fibre (SMF) Max Distance: 20KM Transmitter Wavelength (TX): 1490nm (DFB Laser) Receiver Wavelength (RX): 1310nm (PIN Photo-detector) Fibre Type: 9/125µm SMF Terminations: LC/UPC single optical interface Power Supply: Single +3.3V Case Operating Temperature: 0°C to +70°C (Commercial Grade) Enclosure: Metal (for lower EMI) WARRANTY 3 Years Limited Warranty

name: Plusoptic 1.25G, BiDi SFP, TX1310nm / RX1490nm, 20KM Transceiver, LC Connector for SMF with DOM | TAA compliance
description: Plusoptic 1.25G, BiDi SFP, TX1310nm / RX1490nm, 20KM Transceiver, LC Connector for SMF with DOM | TAA compliance
longDescription: The PlusOptic TAA Compliant 1.25G BiDi SFP Transceiver provides a high-performance and secure solution for extending Gigabit Ethernet networks over significant distances. As a TAA compliant module, it is specifically designed to meet the strict procurement standards required for Australian government and federal projects. By utilising Bi-Directional technology, this transceiver allows for simultaneous data transmission and reception over a single strand of single-mode fibre, effectively doubling your existing fibre capacity while cutting cabling costs in half. Engineered for reliability, this module supports data rates up to 1.25Gb/s with a reach of 20KM. It operates using a 1310nm FP laser for transmission and a 1490nm PIN photo-detector for reception. This specific wavelength configuration makes it the perfect partner for the BISFP-D-20-PLU module, creating a complete high-speed link. The hot-pluggable Small Form Factor Pluggable footprint ensures that the module can be installed or replaced without interrupting the host device's power, allowing for maximum network uptime. This transceiver is fully compliant with the Multi-Sourcing Agreement and SFF-8472 standards, ensuring seamless interoperability with a wide variety of networking hardware. It features integrated Digital Diagnostic Monitoring, which provides real-time access to critical operating parameters such as temperature, supply voltage, and optical power levels. These diagnostics enable network administrators to perform proactive maintenance and quickly troubleshoot potential issues before they impact performance. Housed in a durable metal enclosure to minimise electromagnetic interference, the module is built to perform in commercial environments with an operating temperature range of 0°C to +70°C. Its RoHS compliant and lead-free construction aligns with modern environmental standards. With the added assurance of TAA compliance and a robust 3-year warranty, this PlusOptic SFP is a professional-grade choice for government, enterprise, and educational fibre optic infrastructures. FEATURES TAA Compliant for secure government and federal procurement Bi-Directional operation over a single strand of Single-Mode Fibre Supports data rates up to 1.25Gb/s Maximum transmission distance of 20KM TX1310nm/RX1490nm wavelengths for efficient single-fibre communication Hot-pluggable SFP footprint for easy maintenance Integrated Digital Diagnostic Monitoring for real-time tracking Metal enclosure for reduced electromagnetic interference Low power dissipation for energy efficiency RoHS compliant and lead-free SPECIFICATIONS Part Number: BISFP-U-20-PLU Data Rate: 1.25Gb/s Wavelength (TX): 1310nm Wavelength (RX): 1490nm Distance: 20KM Fibre Type: 9/125µm SMF Connector: LC/UPC Transmitter Type: FP Laser Receiver Type: PIN Photo-detector Power Supply: +3.3V Operating Temperature: 0°C to +70°C Compliance: TAA, MSA, SFF-8472, RoHS Monitoring: DOM Supported WARRANTY 3 Years Limited Warranty

name: Plusoptic 1.25G, BiDi SFP, TX1490nm / RX1550nm, 80KM Transceiver, LC Connector for SMF with DDMI
description: Plusoptic 1.25G, BiDi SFP, TX1490nm / RX1550nm, 80KM Transceiver, LC Connector for SMF with DDMI
longDescription: The Plusoptic 1.25G BiDi SFP Transceiver is a high-performance and cost-effective solution for extending your network over long distances. This hot-pluggable module allows for data transmission up to 80km over a single-mode fibre optic cable, making it ideal for telecommunication providers, data centres, and large enterprise networks. Its bidirectional capability means it transmits and receives signals on different wavelengths over a single fibre, effectively doubling your network's capacity without the need for additional cabling. This transceiver is perfect for applications such as Gigabit Ethernet, Fibre Channel, and switch-to-switch interfaces. This transceiver is built for reliability and ease of use. It features a hot-pluggable SFP footprint, allowing for installation and removal without shutting down your network equipment. The inclusion of Digital Diagnostic Monitoring (DDM) provides real-time access to crucial operating parameters, including temperature, laser bias current, and optical power, enabling proactive network maintenance. The rugged metal enclosure minimises electromagnetic interference (EMI) and provides excellent electrostatic discharge (ESD) protection, ensuring stable performance in demanding environments. Engineered for compatibility, this Plusoptic transceiver adheres to the SFP Multi-Source Agreement (MSA) and SFF-8472 standards. This ensures seamless integration with a wide range of networking equipment from various manufacturers. With its low power consumption and robust design, this transceiver offers a dependable and energy-efficient solution for extending your network reach. The use of a 1490nm DFB laser for transmitting and a 1550nm PIN photodetector for receiving ensures clear and consistent signal integrity over the entire 80km distance. This makes it an excellent choice for critical network links where performance and uptime are paramount. Whether you are upgrading an existing network or building a new one, this transceiver provides the performance and reliability needed for modern high-speed data transmission. FEATURES Supports dual data-rates of 1.25Gbps/1.0625Gbps Hot-pluggable SFP footprint Bi-Directional LC connector 1490nm DFB laser and 1550nm PIN photodetector Applicable for 80km Single-Mode Fibre connection Low power consumption Digital Diagnostic Monitor Interface (DDMI) Compliant with SFP MSA and SFF-8472 Very low EMI and excellent ESD protection SPECIFICATIONS Device Type: SFP Data Rate: 1.25Gbps Wavelength: TX1490nm / RX1550nm Max Distance: 80km Connector: Simplex LC Fibre Type: SMF Power Consumption: Operating Temperature: 0°C to 70°C (Commercial) DDMI: Yes WARRANTY 3-Years Limited Warranty

description: Converter 100G QSFP28 to 25G SFP28 module | Plusoptic CVR-QSFP28-SFP28-25G
longDescription: Converter 100G QSFP28 to 25G SFP28 module | Plusoptic CVR-QSFP28-SFP28-25GThe QSFP28 to SFP28 Adapter (QSA) Module offers 25 Gigabit Ethernet connectivity for Quad Small Form-Factor Pluggable (QSFP28)-only platforms. It allows smooth and cost-effective migration to 100 Gigabit Ethernet by providing an option to use lower-speed Enhanced Small Form-Factor Pluggable (SFP28) modules in empty QSFP28 ports, or when the other end of the network is running at lower speeds. The QSA Module interoperates with all major optical modules and direct attached copper cable vendors. Its design assures minimum loss on the conversion path between the QSFP28 cage and the SFP28 receptacle. The high-speed data channel of the SFP28 receptacle is connected to lane 1 of the QSFP28 connector. The three remaining channels on the QSFP28 connector are not connected. With this adapter, customers have the flexibility to use any SFP28 module or cable to connect to a lower-speed port on the other end of the network. This flexibility allows a cost-effective transition to 100 Gigabit Ethernet by maximizing the use of high-density 100 Gigabit Ethernet QSFP28 platforms. This adapter supports all SFP28 optics and cable reaches. Compatible switch models and SFP28 modules. Qualified for 10GbE SFP+ and 1GbE SFP transceivers meeting the Small Form Factor Pluggable (SFP) Transceiver Multi-source Agreement (MSA). The QSA module provides a solution for integrating systems using different vendors' equipment, is vendor agnostic, and provides a direct path to the SFP port unit’s memory.FEATURES Trouble-free installation and network bring-up Compliant with industry standards: SFF-8665 Compliant with industry standards: SFF-8432 Precision process control for minimization of pair-to-pair skew 1 independent duplex channels operating at 25Gbps, also support for 10Gbps, 5Gbp data rates All-metal housing for superior EMI performance 100ohm differential impedance system Operating case temperature: -20 to 85℃ Low insertion loss Low crosstalk Secure latching mechanism RoHS compliant Compatible with RoHS Single +3.3V power supply APLICATIONS Low EMI radiation Switches, servers, and routers Telecommunication and wireless infrastructure Test and measurement equipment Networked storage systems Data Center networks Storage area networks WARRANTY3-year limited warranty

name: D-Link | DGS-1210-20 | 20 Port Gigabit Smart Managed Switch with 20 RJ45 and 4 SFP (Combo) Ports
description: D-Link | DGS-1210-20 | 20 Port Gigabit Smart Managed Switch with 20 RJ45 and 4 SFP (Combo) Ports
longDescription: D-Link | DGS-1210-20 | 20 Port Gigabit Smart Managed Switch with 20 RJ45 and 4 SFP (Combo) PortsThe D-Link DGS-1210 Series Smart Managed Switches are the latest generation of switches to provide increased Power over Ethernet (PoE) output, a range of physical interface types, multiple management interfaces, and advanced Layer 2 features. With all of these features combined, the DGS-1210 Series provides a cost-efficient and flexible solution for expanding any business network. Seamless Integration The DGS-1210 Series includes a wide range of port and media types, including 10/100/1000BASE-T RJ-45 ports, 100/1000 Mbps combo ports, and 100/1000 Mbps SFP ports. The DGS-1210-10, DGS-1210-26, DGS-1210.10P and DGS-1210-10MP models feature 2 100/1000 Mbps SFP ports, while all other DGS-1210 Series models feature 4 GbE/SFP combo ports, allowing you to choose the most suitable media type for your requirements. All DGS-1210 Series PoE switches include support for IEEE 802.3af/at and higher power budgets, allowing more PoE devices to be powered by the switch and for devices to be installed in remote locations without immediate access to power outlets. Advanced Features The DGS-1210 Series comes equipped with a complete lineup of L2 features, including IGMP snooping, port mirroring, Spanning Tree Protocol (STP), and Link Aggregation Control Protocol (LACP). The IEEE 802.3x Flow Control function allows servers to directly connect to the switch for fast, reliable data transfers. The DGS-1210 Series also supports advanced features such as static routes, which allow network administrators to divide the network into VLANs, increasing network efficiency. Network maintenance features include loopback detection and cable diagnostics. Loopback detection significantly speeds up troubleshooting by automatically detecting and shutting down switching loops. The cable diagnostics feature, designed primarily for administrators and customer service representatives, determines the cable quality and quickly discovers errors, allowing for hassle-free diagnostics and maintenance. Automatic Configuration The DGS-1210 Series supports Auto Voice VLAN and Surveillance Mode, which allows voice and video traffic to be automatically identified and handled differently than regular network traffic. Auto Voice VLAN detects Voice over IP (VoIP) traffic and automatically segments it from the rest of the network, adding a layer of isolation and allowing Quality of Service (QoS) to be applied. Surveillance Mode detects compatible ONVIF cameras and places them in a surveillance VLAN, allowing a single switch to be used for voice, video, and data, removing the need for dedicated hardware and reducing maintenance costs. Surveillance Mode also includes its own Web UI, making surveillance features easily accessible and simplifying management of your surveillance network. Advanced Access Control D-Link’s innovative Safeguard Engine helps to protect the switches against traffic flooding caused by malicious attacks. The DGS-1210 Series supports 802.1X port-based authentication, allowing the clients to be authenticated through external RADIUS servers. The Access Control List (ACL) feature helps to enhance network security and helps to protect the internal IT network. The DGS-1210 Series also features Address Resolution Protocol (ARP) spoofing prevention, which helps to provi...

longDescription: 5m SC-ST OM4 Multimode Fibre Optic Cable Aqua Fibre patch cables are the thin, flexible fibres of glass that carry data, telephone conversations and emails high speed all over the world in a matter of seconds with much less interference than copper patch lead. Fibre Optic cables need less amplification to boost signals so they travel better over longer distances. 4Cabling 's OM4 laser optimised multimode fibre optic patch leads provide the connection from Ethernet 10Mbit/s to 10Gbit/s Gigabit Ethernet, they are the cost-effective way to replace your copper-based patch leads. 4Cabling fibre optic cable is immune to EMI/ RFI frequency, mainly used on patch panels for the connection between outlets and terminal equipment. The multimode optical fibre cables are manufactured using LSZH cables which conform to IEC, EIA TIA and Telcordia standards. 4Cabling Multimode Fibre Optics leads is the cost-effective way of your cabling solution. longDescription: 1.5m SC-SC OS1 / OS2 Singlemode Fibre Optic Cable: Black Fibre patch cables are the thin, flexible fibres of glass that carry data, telephone conversations and emails high speed all over the world in a matter of seconds with much less interference than copper patch lead. Fibre Optic cables need less amplification to boost signals so they travel better over longer distances. 4Cabling 's OS1 / OS2 singlemode fibre optic patch leads provide the connection from Ethernet 10Mbit/s to 10Gbit/s Gigabit Ethernet, they are the cost-effective way to replace your copper-based patch leads. 4Cabling fibre optic cable is immune to EMI/ RFI frequency, mainly used on patch panels for the connection between outlets and terminal equipment. The singlemode optical fibre cables are manufactured using LSZH cables which conform to IEC, EIA TIA and Telcordia standards. 4Cabling Singlemode Fibre Optics leads is the cost-effective way of your cabling solution. Application: Cross-connect patching Backbone application in building Termination enclosure for equipment patching Equipment to equipment patching Conforms to ISO/ IEC 11801 Individually labelled for lead tracing Low smoke zero halogen (LSZH) cable Manufactured with stringent quality control UPC (Ultra Physical Contact) connector All leads are supplied with a factory test report OS2 fibre patch leads conform to ITU-T G.652.D, TIA/EIA 492CAAB Duplex configurable assemblies for LC, SC, ST & SC/A, as well as MTRJ Patch leads All ends are polished and individually inspected for correct polishing Supports high-speed multi-channel data, voice & video applications Fibre specification: Mode: OS1 / OS2 Singlemode Fibre Terminations: SC-SC Length: 1.5m Colour: Black Oversleeving: 2mm WARRANTY 3 year limited warranty. name: Grandstream GWN7672 | 2x2x2 Tri-Band Wi-Fi 7 Indoor AP, 2 x 5G Ethernet, Bluetooth
description: Grandstream GWN7672 | 2x2x2 Tri-Band Wi-Fi 7 Indoor AP, 2 x 5G Ethernet, Bluetooth
longDescription: The Grandstream GWN7672 is a next-generation enterprise-grade Wi-Fi 7 access point designed for high-density environments requiring ultra-fast throughput and minimal latency. This tri-band powerhouse delivers an impressive 11Gbps aggregate wireless throughput (BE11000), making it the perfect solution for modern businesses, retail spaces, and advanced home offices. By utilising the 6GHz band alongside traditional 2.4GHz and 5GHz frequencies, it ensures maximum bandwidth availability for bandwidth-hungry applications like 4K/8K streaming and real-time video conferencing. Equipped with advanced Wi-Fi 7 technologies, the GWN7672 features Multi-Link Operation (MLO) and 4096-QAM modulation to significantly boost data transfer rates and reliability. Multi-RU and Preamble Puncturing further enhance efficiency by reducing interference in congested RF environments. With a coverage range of up to 175 meters and the ability to support up to 384 concurrent clients, this access point provides robust connectivity across large floor plans without compromising on performance. Management is flexible and cost-effective with Grandstream’s ecosystem. The GWN7672 includes an embedded controller capable of managing up to 50 local APs, or it can be integrated into the free GDMS cloud-based platform or GWN Manager for on-premise software control. Security is paramount, featuring anti-hacking secure boot, critical data lockdown via digital signatures, and unique security certificates per device to ensure your network remains protected against modern threats. Built for the future of networking, the hardware includes a high-speed 2.5G Ethernet port and a 10G SFP+ port for versatile backhaul options. Its sleek indoor design allows for easy wall or ceiling mounting with included kits. Whether you are scaling a professional office network or upgrading a smart home, the GWN7672 offers the cutting-edge performance and stability required for today’s data-intensive digital landscape. FEATURES Tri-band Wi-Fi 7 (802.11be) technology with BE11000 class performance Up to 11Gbps aggregate wireless throughput and 5Gbps wired aggregate throughput Supports up to 384 concurrent Wi-Fi client devices Multi-Link Operation (MLO) and 4K-QAM for enhanced data efficiency Advanced QoS to ensure real-time performance of low-latency applications Embedded controller for local management of up to 50 GWN APs Anti-hacking secure boot and critical data/control lockdown Bluetooth 5.3 for location-based services and asset tracking SPECIFICATIONS Wi-Fi Standards: IEEE 802.11a/b/g/n/ac/ax/be Frequency Bands: 2.4GHz, 5GHz, 6GHz MIMO: 2x2:2 (2.4GHz), 2x2:2 (5GHz), 2x2:2 (6GHz) Aggregate Throughput: 11Gbps (Wireless), 5Gbps (Wired) 6GHz Data Rate: Up to 5765Mbps 5GHz Data Rate: Up to 4320Mbps 2.4GHz Data Rate: Up to 688Mbps Network Interfaces: 1x 2.5G Ethernet port, 1x 10G SFP+ port Maximum Coverage: Up to 175 meters SSIDs: 48 total (16 per radio) Antennas: 7x internal single frequency antennas Power Consumption: 25W (Maximum) Power Supply: PoE+ 802.3at (Self-power adaptation) Mounting: Indoor wall or ceiling mount (kits included) Bluetooth: Bluetooth Low Energy 5.3 WARRANTY 1-Year Limited Warranty

name: GrandStream | GWN7803P | Enterprise Layer 2+ Managed PoE Network Switch, 24 x GigE, 4 x SFP
description: GrandStream | GWN7803P | Enterprise Layer 2+ Managed PoE Network Switch, 24 x GigE, 4 x SFP
longDescription: The Grandstream GWN7803P is an enterprise-grade Layer 2+ managed network switch designed to empower small-to-medium businesses with a scalable, high-performance networking solution. Equipped with 24 Gigabit Ethernet ports and 4 Gigabit SFP ports, this switch provides the versatility required for modern business infrastructures. It features smart dynamic PoE/PoE+ output with a substantial 360W power budget, making it the perfect hub for powering IP phones, cameras, and Wi-Fi access points directly through the data cable. Security is at the forefront of the GWN7803P design, offering advanced protections including ARP Inspection, IP Source Guard, and DoS attack prevention. With support for advanced VLAN segmentation and IGMP/MLD Snooping, it ensures your network traffic is both secure and optimised for peak performance. Whether you are managing high-bandwidth video streams or sensitive VoIP data, this switch maintains low latency and high reliability across the entire network. Management is flexible and comprehensive, catering to various technical preferences. You can manage the GWN7803P via its local web-based controller, the GWN.Cloud platform, or the on-premise GWN Manager software. This flexibility allows for seamless remote monitoring and configuration, ensuring that your network stays up and running without the need for constant on-site intervention. It also supports IPv6 and IPv4 dual-stack deployment for future-proof connectivity. Built for durability and ease of installation, the switch includes rack-mount brackets and features two integrated fans to maintain optimal operating temperatures under heavy PoE loads. The GWN7803P combines professional-level switching capabilities with a user-friendly interface, making it an essential component for any growing enterprise looking to upgrade their network backbone with reliable Power over Ethernet technology. FEATURES 24 Gigabit Ethernet ports and 4 Gigabit SFP ports IEEE 802.3af/at PoE/PoE+ compliant with 360W total power budget Smart power control for dynamic PoE allocation per port Supports advanced VLAN, QoS, and IGMP/MLD Snooping Comprehensive security with ARP Inspection, IP Source Guard, and DoS protection Multiple management options: Local Web UI, GWN.Cloud, and GWN Manager IPv6 and IPv4 dual-stack support Desktop, wall-mount, or rack-mount installation SPECIFICATIONS Model: GWN7803P Ethernet Ports: 24x10/100/1000Mbps RJ45 ports SFP Ports: 4x1000Mbps SFP ports PoE Standard: IEEE 802.3af/at Max PoE Budget: 360W Max PoE Power per Port: 30W Switching Capacity: 56Gbps Total Non-blocking Throughput: 28Gbps Forwarding Rate: 41.66Mpps Packet Buffer: 4.1MB MAC Address Table: 8K VLANs: 4K Console Port: 1x Console port Fans: 2 integrated fans Mounting: Rack-mountable (brackets included) Power Supply: Integrated 400W Dimensions: 440mm(L)*200mm(W)*44mm(H) Weight: 3.3kg WARRANTY 3-Year Limited Warranty

name: GrandStream | GWN7806 | Enterprise Layer 2+ Managed Network Switch, 48 x GigE, 6 x SFP+
description: GrandStream | GWN7806 | Enterprise Layer 2+ Managed Network Switch, 48 x GigE, 6 x SFP+
longDescription: The Grandstream GWN7806 is a high-performance Layer 2+ managed network switch designed to empower small-to-medium enterprises with a scalable, secure, and intelligent networking foundation. Featuring 48 Gigabit Ethernet ports and 6 elite 10Gigabit SFP+ ports, it delivers a massive 216Gbps switching capacity to handle data-intensive applications with ease. This switch is the ideal backbone for businesses requiring high-speed fiber uplinks and extensive copper connectivity without the need for PoE. Management is streamlined through multiple avenues, including a local web interface, CLI, or Grandstream’s powerful cloud and on-premise platforms, GWN.Cloud and GWN Manager. The GWN7806 supports advanced VLAN for sophisticated traffic segmentation and state-of-the-art QoS to ensure that critical voice and video traffic always receives priority. Its stacking capability allows for the unified management of up to 16 switches, greatly reducing administrative overhead as your infrastructure grows. Security is at the forefront of the GWN7806 design, featuring a comprehensive suite of protections including 802.1X authentication, DHCP Snooping, and IP Source Guard. These multi-layer security protocols defend your network against common threats like DoS attacks and ARP spoofing, providing a hardened environment for sensitive business data. Reliability is further bolstered by dual-boot support and dual system file redundancy, ensuring maximum uptime and resilient performance in demanding environments. Built for efficiency and longevity, the GWN7806 incorporates smart energy-saving technology and a robust thermal design with three integrated fans. Its rack-mountable form factor and included mounting kits make it ready for professional server room installation right out of the box. With its combination of high-density port counts, 10G uplinks, and enterprise-grade management features, the GWN7806 stands as a premier value-driven solution for modern Australian business networks. FEATURES 48 Gigabit Ethernet ports and 6 10Gigabit SFP+ ports 216Gbps total switching capacity for high-speed data handling Advanced Layer 2+ management including static routing and 4K VLANs Comprehensive security with ARP Inspection, IP Source Guard, and DoS protection Flexible management via GWN.Cloud, GWN Manager, or local Web UI Supports stacking for easy management of up to 16 switches Reliability features including dual boot and dual system file redundancy SPECIFICATIONS Gigabit Ethernet Ports: 48 10G SFP+ Ports: 6 Console Port: 1 Switching Capacity: 216Gbps Total Non-blocking Throughput: 108Gbps Forwarding Rate: 160.704Mpps Packet Buffer: 16Mb MAC Address Table: 32K (Static, Dynamic, Filtering, Sticky) VLANs: 4K (Port-based, 802.1Q, MAC-based, Protocol-based, Voice) Multicast: IGMP Snooping (v1/v2/v3), MLD Snooping (v1/v2) Quality of Service: Port priority, Queue scheduling (SP, WRR, WFQ) Security: 802.1X, RADIUS, AAA, TACACS+, SSH, HTTPS Mounting: Desktop or 1U Rack-mount (Kits included) Power Supply: Internal 60W (100-240VAC, 50/60Hz) Fans: 3 Dimensions: 440x301x44mm Weight: 4.0kg WARRANTY 3-Year Limited Warranty

name: GrandStream | GR-UCM6301 | 1 FXO, 1FXS, 500 Users
description: GrandStream | GR-UCM6301 | 1 FXO, 1FXS, 500 Users
longDescription: The Grandstream UCM6301 is a professional-grade IP PBX appliance designed to unify business communications into one manageable network. It supports up to 500 users and 75 concurrent calls, providing a powerful yet scalable solution for small to medium businesses. This device integrates voice, video calling, video conferencing, video surveillance, and data tools, allowing employees to connect across desktops and mobile devices seamlessly. Equipped with an advanced hardware platform, the UCM6301 features an integrated heart for high-end security and reliability. It includes a built-in cross-platform collaboration solution that pairs with the Grandstream Wave app, enabling remote workers to communicate effectively without complex configurations. The system supports Full HD video conferencing and high-quality voice codecs to ensure crystal-clear communication quality at all times. Management is simplified through the Grandstream Device Management System (GDMS), a centralised cloud-based interface for provisioning and monitoring. This eliminates the need for expensive on-site IT maintenance by allowing for remote configuration and firmware updates. The UCM6301 also features an automated NAT traversal service to facilitate secure remote connections, making it an ideal hub for modern, flexible work environments. Built for performance, the unit includes dual Gigabit ports with integrated PoE+, ensuring fast data transfer and easy installation. name: LEVITON - Opt-X SDX Medium Wall Mount Enclosure accepts up to 4 Components
description: LEVITON - Opt-X SDX Medium Wall Mount Enclosure accepts up to 4 Components
longDescription: The Opt-X SDX Wall-Mount Fibre Optic Enclosure is engineered for high-performance interconnect or cross-connect between fibre optic cables and active equipment, all while occupying minimal wall space. Its versatile design facilitates easy field termination of fibre connectors, splicing, or the integration of pre-terminated plug-and-play solutions. This makes it an ideal centralisation point for managing your fibre optic network infrastructure with efficiency and reliability. Primarily designed for controlled indoor applications, this enclosure excels in environments such as entrance facilities, equipment rooms, and telecommunications closets. The dual-door configuration provides separate, easy access to service and customer sides via convenient slam latches. Its low-profile depth ensures it protrudes minimally from the wall, making it perfect for high-traffic or space-constrained areas. Constructed from robust 16-gauge steel, the enclosure offers enhanced durability and protection for your critical network connections. Practical features like removable cable entry/exit grommets allow for the smooth installation of pre-terminated fibre trunks, protect cabling, and minimise dust buildup. For added security and cable management, optional key/lock kits and cable strain-relief mounting kits are also available, making this a secure and adaptable solution for any network. longDescription: Effortlessly connect your legacy RS-232 serial devices to a modern computer with the Moxa UPort 1110 USB-to-Serial Converter. This compact and high-performance adapter is the perfect solution for mobile, instrumentation, and point-of-sale applications, providing a simple plug-and-play experience. It eliminates the need for older, COM port-equipped computers, bridging the gap between your trusted serial hardware and contemporary USB-C or USB-A ports, ensuring your equipment remains productive and accessible. Engineered for reliability and speed, the UPort 1110 supports high-speed data transmission rates up to 921.6kbps, making it suitable for data-intensive applications. It draws power directly from the USB port, removing the need for an external power adapter and reducing clutter in your workspace. This feature, combined with its pocket-sized design, makes it an exceptionally portable tool for engineers and technicians who work in the field or move between different workstations. The UPort 1110 is built to withstand the rigours of professional environments, featuring 15kV ESD protection to safeguard your connected devices against electrostatic discharge. Moxa provides comprehensive driver support for a wide range of operating systems, including Windows, macOS, and Linux, ensuring seamless compatibility and a quick setup process. The inclusion of on-chip hardware and software flow control guarantees your data is transmitted without loss or corruption, delivering the dependable performance Moxa is known for. This converter is more than just an adapter; it's an investment in operational continuity. By enabling devices like barcode scanners, PLCs, scientific instruments, and medical equipment to interface with modern PCs and laptops, the UPort 1110 extends the life of valuable hardware. Its robust construction and stable performance make it the ideal choice for industrial automation, retail, and laboratory settings where a reliable serial connection is critical. name: MPO Cable Indoor Riser MM OM4 12 Core - MPO Female to LC Duplex Fanout 10m Type B
description: MPO Cable Indoor Riser MM OM4 12 Core - MPO Female to LC Duplex Fanout 10m Type B
longDescription: This high-density MPO to LC breakout cable is the ultimate solution for modern data centres and high-speed network environments. It is expertly designed to transition a single 12-fibre MPO connector into twelve separate LC connectors, facilitating a smooth and efficient migration from 10GbE to 40GbE or 100GbE. This cable is perfect for connecting high-speed QSFP+ transceivers to existing 10G SFP+ ports, simplifying your network infrastructure and maximising port density without the need for complex patch panels. Engineered for exceptional performance, this cable utilises laser-optimised OM4 multimode fibre. This advanced fibre type allows for high-bandwidth data transmission over greater distances compared to older OM3 standards, ensuring your network is future-proofed for next-generation speeds. The inclusion of high-quality, low-loss MPO and LC connectors with UPC polish guarantees minimal signal degradation and a highly reliable data link, which is critical for mission-critical applications where uptime and data integrity are paramount. Built for safety and durability, the cable features a robust OFNR (Optical Fiber Non-conductive Riser) rated jacket. This flame-retardant rating makes it fully compliant and safe for vertical installations through building floors, in-wall applications, and other non-plenum spaces. The main cable body has a 3.0mm diameter, while the individual fanout legs are a durable 2.0mm, providing a rugged yet flexible solution for routing within server racks and cable management systems. This cable is configured with Type B polarity (key up to key up), which is specifically used for connecting transceivers, ensuring a correct fibre-to-fibre link between devices. The aqua colour of the jacket signifies its OM4 rating for easy identification. The entire assembly is RoHS compliant, confirming it is manufactured without hazardous materials, making it a safe and environmentally conscious choice for your network. FEATURES 12 Fibre Core OM4 Multimode Cable Connectors: MPO Female to 12x LC/UPC Simplex Ideal for 40G/100G to 10G Breakout Applications Type B Polarity for Transceiver-to-Transceiver Connections OFNR (Riser) Rated Jacket for In-Wall Installations RoHS Compliant Durable 3.0mm Main Cable and 2.0mm Fanout Legs SPECIFICATIONS Fibre Mode: Multimode OM4 50/125µm MPO Connector Insertion Loss: ≤0.60dB MPO Connector Return Loss: ≥35dB LC Connector Insertion Loss: ≤0.25dB LC Connector Return Loss: ≥35dB Main Cable Diameter: 3.0mm Fanout Leg Diameter: 2.0mm Jacket Colour: Aqua Operating Temperature: -20°C to +70°C Storage Temperature: -20°C to +70°C WARRANTY 1-Year Limited Warranty

name: PCI NIC, Single Port SFP 100Mb FX with VT6105 Controller
description: PCI NIC, Single Port SFP 100Mb FX with VT6105 Controller
longDescription: Upgrade your network with the NICPCI-1SFP100FX, a high-performance 100Mbps managed PCI bus SFP port fibre NIC. Designed for reliability, this network interface card provides a stable fibre optic connection, perfect for overcoming the distance limitations of traditional copper cabling. It is an ideal solution for fibre-to-the-home (FTTH) and fibre-to-the-desktop (FTTD) applications, offering a direct replacement for networks using standard RJ-45 connections. The plug-and-play SFP port allows you to choose the appropriate SFP module to meet your specific distance requirements, supporting connections from 2km up to 110km. Built on the reliable VIA VT6105M controller, this card ensures consistent performance and wide compatibility. It supports both full-duplex and half-duplex operations, reaching speeds of up to 200Mbps in full-duplex mode. Advanced features such as IEEE 802.3x Flow Control, IEEE 802.1Q VLAN tagging, and PXE Boot Rom support make it a versatile choice for various networking environments. The card's design includes a 50Z heavy gold plate for superior heat dispersion and signal integrity, ensuring long-term stability and performance. The NICPCI-1SFP100FX is designed for easy integration, supporting 32-bit PCI 2.2 buses and including both full-height and low-profile brackets to fit a range of computer chassis, from standard desktops to small form factor systems. It also features advanced management capabilities with DMI 2.0 and ACPI 1.0 support, along with broad OS compatibility, including various versions of Windows, Linux, and UNIX. This comprehensive feature set makes it a flexible and powerful solution for your fibre networking needs. FEATURES Based on the reliable VIA VT6105M controller 100Mbps SFP port compatible with all 100M SFP modules Includes both full-height and low-profile brackets Supports PXE Boot Rom for network booting Compliant with IEEE 802.3u 100Base-FX and IEEE 802.3ah 100Base-LX10/-BX10 standards Full-duplex and half-duplex operation, with speeds up to 200Mbps in full-duplex Supports IEEE 802.3x Flow Control for enhanced operation with switches Supports IP Unicast, broadcast, and multicast address filtering IEEE 802.1p Tagging for prioritising sensitive data IEEE 802.1Q VLAN tagging and GVRP VLAN registration protocol support TCP/IP CPU Task Offload reduces host CPU utilisation Advanced management with DMI 2.0 and ACPI 1.0 support SPECIFICATIONS Controller: VIA VT6105M Bus Type: 32-bit PCI 2.2 Port: 1 x 100M SFP Transmission Speed: 100Mbps (200Mbps in full-duplex) Supported Standards: IEEE 802.3u, IEEE 802.3ah, IEEE 802.3x, IEEE 802.1p, IEEE 802.1Q Power Consumption: 2W Operating Temperature: 0°C - 50°C Storage Temperature: 5°C - 55°C Operating Humidity: 5% - 95% (non-condensing) Dimensions: 120mm x 53mm LED Indicators: Link/Activity (Green), Colour Indication (Orange and Green) OS Support: Windows XP/7/8/Vista/Server 2003/ME/95/98/NT/CE, DOS, various Linux distributions (Ubuntu, SuSE, Fedora, Red Hat), UNIX (Solaris, UnixWare), FreeBSD WARRANTY 1-Year Limited Warranty

name: PCI Express x8 NIC, Dual 10Gbps Copper RJ45 with Intel® X540AT2 Network Controller
description: PCI Express x8 NIC, Dual 10Gbps Copper RJ45 with Intel® X540AT2 Network Controller
longDescription: PCI Express x 8 NIC, Dual 10Gbps Copper RJ45 with Intel® X540AT2 Network ControllerPCIE NIC, Dual Port SFP+ Server Adapters with SFP+ connectivity are the most flexible and scalable Ethernet adapters to meet the demands of today’s data center environments. Datacenter networks are being pushed to their limits. The escalating deployments of servers with multi-core processors and demanding applications such as High Performance Computing (HPC), database clusters, and video-on-demand are driving the need for 10 Gigabit connections. Customers require flexible and scalable I/O solutions to meet the rigorous requirements of running mission-critical applications in virtualized and unified storage environments. 10 Gigabit for the Broad Market The NICPCIE-10G-2RJ45 is the latest innovation in Intel's leadership to drive 10 Gigabit Ethernet into the broader server market. This adapter hosts Intel's latest Ethernet silicon, the Intel Ethernet Controller X540, which is used by many OEMs as a single chip solution for LAN on Motherboard (LOM) to deliver 10 Gigabit Ethernet(10 GbE) on the latest server platforms10G BASE-T Simplifies the Transition to 10 GbE The NICPCIE-10G-2RJ45 10GBase-T works with existing networks today. It works with legacy Gigabit Ethernet (GbE) switches and Cat 6A cabling. Install the NICPCIE-10G-2RJ45 10GBase-T adapter into a server and the auto-negotiation between 1 GbE and 10GbE provides the necessary backwards compatibility that most customers require for a smooth transition and easy migration to 10 GbE. When time and budget allows, 10GBASE-T switches can be added any time to experience the full benefits of 10GbE. 10GBASE-T uses the copper twisted pair cables that are very familiar to IT professionals today. It is everything you know and love about 1000BASE-T. The knowledge, training and investment in BASE-T are preserved. 10GBASE-T is the easiest and most versatile 10 GbE and you can deploy it anywhere in your data center. name: Cisco compatible (QSFP-40G-LR4-S QSFP-40GE-LR4) 40G, QSFP+, 1310nm, 10KM Transceiver, LC Connector for SMF with DOM
description: Cisco compatible (QSFP-40G-LR4-S QSFP-40GE-LR4) 40G, QSFP+, 1310nm, 10KM Transceiver, LC Connector for SMF with DOM
longDescription: QSFP+ LR4 is designed to operate over single-mode fibre system using 4X10 CWDM channel in 1310 band and links up to 10km. The module converts 4 inputs channel of 10Gb/s electrical data to 4 CWDM optical signals, and multiplexes them into a single channel for 40Gb/s optical transmission. Reversely, on the receiver side, the module optically de-multiplexes a 40Gb/s input into 4 CWDM channels signals, and converts them to 4 channel output electrical data. The central wavelengths of the 4 CWDM channels are 1271, 1291, 1311 and 1331nm. It contains a duplex LC connector for the optical interface and a 38-pin connector for the electrical interface. Single-mode fibre (SMF) is applied in this module. This product converts the 4-channel 10Gb/s electrical input data into CWDM optical signals (light), by a 4- wavelength Distributed Feedback Laser (DFB) array. The 4 wavelengths are multiplexed into a single 40Gb/s data, propagating out of the transmitter module via the SMF. The receiver module accepts the 40Gb/s optical signals input, and de-multiplexes it into 4 CWDM 10Gb/s channels.
