name: Cisco compatible (QSFP-40G-SR4-S) 40G, QSFP+, 850nm, 150M Transceiver, MTP/MPO Connector for MMF with DOM
description: Cisco compatible (QSFP-40G-SR4-S) 40G, QSFP+, 850nm, 150M Transceiver, MTP/MPO Connector for MMF with DOM
longDescription: Designed for use in 40 Gigabit per second links over multimode fibre. They are compliant with the QSFP+ MSA and IEEE 802.3ba 40GBASE-SR4. The optical transmitter portion of the transceiver incorporates a 4-channel VCSEL (Vertical Cavity Surface Emitting Laser) array, a 4-channel input buffer and laser driver, diagnostic monitors, control and bias blocks. For module control, the control interface incorporates a Two Wire Serial interface of clock and data signals. Diagnostic monitors for VCSEL bias, module temperature, transmitted optical power, received optical power and supply voltage are implemented and results are available through the TWS interface. Alarm and warning thresholds are established for the monitored attributes. Flags are set and interrupts generated when the attributes are outside the thresholds. Flags are also set and interrupts generated for loss of input signal (LOS) and transmitter fault conditions. All flags are latched and will remain set even if the condition initiating the latch clears and operation resumes. All interrupts can be masked and flags are reset by reading the appropriate flag register. The optical output will squelch for loss of input signal unless squelch is disabled. Fault detection or channel deactivation through the TWS interface will disable the channel. Status, alarm/warning and fault information are available via the TWS interface. The optical receiver portion of the transceiver incorporates a 4-channel PIN photodiode array, a 4-channel TIA array, a 4 channel output buffer, diagnostic monitors, and control and bias blocks. Diagnostic monitors for optical input power are implemented and results are available through the TWS interface. Alarm and warning thresholds are established for the monitored attributes. Flags are set and interrupts generated when the attributes are outside the thresholds. Flags are also set and interrupts generated for loss of optical input signal (LOS). All flags are latched and will remain set even if the condition initiating the flag clears and operation resumes. All interrupts can be masked and flags are reset upon reading the appropriate flag register. The electrical output will squelch for loss of input signal (unless squelch is disabled) and channel de-activation through TWS interface. Status and alarm/warning information are available via the TWS interface.FEATURES High Channel Capacity: 40 Gbps per module Up to 11.1Gbps Data rate per channel Maximum link length of 100m links on OM3 multimode fibre or 150m links on OM4 multimode fibre High Reliability 850nm VCSEL technology Electrically hot-pluggable Digital diagnostic SFF-8436 compliant Case operating temperature range 0°C to 70°C Power dissipation < 1.5 W APPLICATIONS 40G Ethernet Infiniband QDR Fibre channel STANDARDS Compliant to IEEE 802.3ba Compliant to SFF-8436 RoHS Compliant WARRANTY3-years limited warrantyTAA-approved SFPs available upon request, Contact us for more details.

name: Ruggedcom Compatible 100Base SFP, 1310nm, 10KM Transceiver, LC Connector for SMF with DDMI. Industrial Temperature Rated
description: Ruggedcom Compatible 100Base SFP, 1310nm, 10KM Transceiver, LC Connector for SMF with DDMI. Industrial Temperature Rated
longDescription: Engineered for reliability in harsh environments, this industrial-grade SFP transceiver is fully compatible with Ruggedcom equipment, ensuring seamless network integration. It provides robust 100Base-LX Ethernet connectivity over long distances, making it an ideal solution for extending your network reach in demanding industrial settings. The hot-pluggable nature of this transceiver allows for effortless installation and replacement without the need to power down your critical network infrastructure, maximising uptime and simplifying maintenance procedures. This transceiver is specifically designed for single-mode fibre optic cables, utilising a 1310nm wavelength to transmit data reliably up to 10 kilometres. This long-distance capability is essential for large-scale industrial applications, campus networks, and sprawling outdoor installations where network points are significantly dispersed. The use of a standard LC duplex connector ensures compatibility with a wide range of fibre optic patch cables and networking equipment, providing flexibility in your network design and deployment. Built to withstand extreme operational demands, this module is industrial temperature rated, capable of performing in environments with temperatures ranging from -40°C to +85°C. This resilience makes it a perfect choice for outdoor enclosures, unheated facilities, and other challenging locations where standard commercial-grade components would fail. Furthermore, the inclusion of Digital Diagnostic Monitoring (DDM) and Digital Optical Monitoring (DOM) provides real-time insights into the transceiver's performance, including temperature, voltage, and signal strength, allowing for proactive network management and troubleshooting. The metal enclosure of the transceiver provides superior electro-magnetic interference (EMI) protection, which is crucial in industrial environments where heavy machinery and other electrical equipment can disrupt network signals. This focus on durability and performance, combined with its compliance with the Small Form Factor Pluggable Multi-Sourcing Agreement (MSA), guarantees a high-quality, interoperable solution for your industrial networking needs, ensuring both reliability and a long service life. FEATURES Fully compatible with Ruggedcom networking equipment Hot-pluggable SFP footprint for easy installation Industrial operating temperature range of -40°C to +85°C Supports Digital Diagnostic Monitoring (DDM) and Digital Optical Monitoring (DOM) Durable metal enclosure for reduced EMI RoHS compliant and lead-free Duplex LC connector SPECIFICATIONS SKU: SFP-100FE-LX-RUGi Data Rate: 100Mbps Wavelength: 1310nm Transmission Distance: Up to 10km Fibre Type: Single-Mode Fibre (SMF) Connector: Duplex LC Power Supply: +3.3V WARRANTY 3-Years Limited Warranty

longDescription: Upgrade your network infrastructure with this TAA Compliant Cisco Compatible SFP-10G-LR Transceiver, designed to deliver reliable, high-speed connectivity for government and enterprise environments. This 10 Gigabit SFP+ module is engineered for seamless interoperability with Cisco switches and routers, providing a cost-effective and functionally identical alternative to OEM transceivers. It is fully Trade Agreements Act (TAA) compliant, making it suitable for federal contracts and GSA schedule deployments. Supporting data rates up to 10.3125Gbps, this single-mode fibre (SMF) transceiver operates on a 1310nm wavelength to transmit data up to 10km. It features a standard Duplex LC connector for easy integration into existing fibre plants and utilises a Distributed Feedback (DFB) laser for consistent signal integrity over long distances. The module is ideal for high-speed data links in data centres, campus networks, and service provider transport applications. This SFP+ transceiver is equipped with Digital Optical Monitoring (DOM), also known as Digital Diagnostic Monitoring (DDM). This technology allows administrators to monitor real-time parameters such as optical output power, optical input power, temperature, laser bias current, and transceiver supply voltage, ensuring proactive network management. The hot-swappable design enables quick installation and replacement without disrupting network operations. This allows network administrators to access real-time operating parameters such as optical power, temperature, and voltage for proactive maintenance and troubleshooting. Specifically programmed and tested for Fortinet devices, this transceiver ensures seamless compatibility and plug-and-play functionality. It offers an identical performance to OEM parts but at a fraction of the cost, providing a smart and efficient solution for scaling your network infrastructure. Its low power consumption also contributes to a more energy-efficient and cost-effective network operation. name: Cisco compatible (GLC-EX-SMD GLC-LH40-SM) 1.25G, SFP, 1310nm, 40KM Transceiver, LC Connector for SMF with DOM
description: Cisco compatible (GLC-EX-SMD GLC-LH40-SM) 1.25G, SFP, 1310nm, 40KM Transceiver, LC Connector for SMF with DOM
longDescription: These are Small Form Factor Pluggable (SFP) transceivers are compatible with the Small Form Factor Pluggable Multi-Sourcing Agreement (MSA). The transceiver consists of five sections: the LD driver, the limiting amplifier, the digital diagnostic monitor, the DFB laser and the PIN photo-detector. longDescription: Small Form Factor Pluggable (SFP) transceivers are compatible with the Small Form Factor Pluggable Multi-Sourcing Agreement (MSA). The transceiver consists of five sections: the LD driver, the limiting amplifier, the digital diagnostic monitor, the FP laser and the PIN photo-detector. The module data link up to 10KM in 9/125um single mode fibre. The optical output can be disabled by a TTL logic high-level input of Tx Disable, and the system also can disable the module via I2C. Tx Fault is provided to indicate that degradation of the laser. Loss of signal (LOS) output is provided to indicate the loss of an input optical signal of receiver or the link status with partner. The system can also get the LOS (or Link)/Disable/Fault information via I2C register access.FEATURES Up to 2.25Gb/s data links Up to 20km on 9/125µm SMF 1310nm FP laser Hot-pluggable SFP footprint Duplex LC/UPC type pluggable optical interface Single 3.3V power supply RoHS compliant and lead-free Support Digital Diagnostic Monitoring interface (DDM) Case operating temperature Commercial: 0°C to +70°C APPLICATIONS Switch to Switch Interface 1.25Gbps 1000Base-LX 1G/2G Fibre Channel Switched Backplane Applications Router/Server Interface Other Optical Links WARRANTY3-years limited warrantyTAA-approved SFPs available upon request, Contact us for more details.

With low power dissipation and RoHS compliance, it offers an environmentally friendly and energy-efficient solution for your networking needs. It operates from a single +3.3V power supply and is compliant with SFF-8472 standards. Ideal for a range of applications, including Gigabit Ethernet, Fibre Channel, and switch-to-switch interfaces, the Plusoptic SFP transceiver is a reliable choice for building high-speed, robust network infrastructures. Its DDM capabilities provide valuable insights into module performance, enabling proactive network management and troubleshooting. description: CAT6A U/FTP Cable on Wooden Drum w/ LSZH Jacket | 305m Roll Blue
longDescription: This high-performance Category 6A networking cable provides a robust solution for 10G Ethernet applications. It is engineered with a U/FTP (Unshielded/Foiled Twisted Pair) construction, where each of the four conductor pairs is individually wrapped in an Al/Mylar foil screen. This superior shielding design is highly effective at minimising internal crosstalk (NEXT) and protecting against external electromagnetic interference (EMI), ensuring outstanding signal integrity for reliable high-speed data transmission up to 500MHz. Featuring 23AWG solid bare copper conductors, this cable ensures excellent conductivity and minimal signal loss over distance. The conductors are insulated with a skin-foam-skin PE, and the cable includes a drain wire for simple and effective grounding of the individual pair shields. longDescription: The Teltonika RUT241-eSIM is a compact yet powerful industrial 4G LTE Cat 4 router, perfect for a wide range of M2M and IoT applications across Australia. Experience seamless connectivity with its integrated eSIM functionality, supporting up to seven profiles for effortless network switching without the hassle of physical SIM cards. Boasting two 10/100 Ethernet ports and 2.4GHz Wi-Fi (802.11 b/g/n), this router ensures reliable internet access for multiple devices. name: Teltonika | TRB501 | 5G Industrial Gateway, backwards compatible with 4G (LTE CAT 20) and 3G, up to 2.5 Gbps
description: Teltonika | TRB501 | 5G Industrial Gateway, backwards compatible with 4G (LTE CAT 20) and 3G, up to 2.5 Gbps
longDescription: The Teltonika TRB501 is a next-generation industrial 5G gateway designed to deliver ultra-high-speed connectivity for mission-critical applications. Built on the 3GPP Release 16 standard, it provides significantly lower latency and improved spectrum efficiency, making it the perfect solution for advanced automation, remote heavy machinery operation, and real-time data analysis. Its high-performance 5G modem is backwards compatible with 4G (LTE Cat 20) and 3G networks, ensuring consistent uptime even in areas where 5G coverage is still expanding. Equipped with a powerful 2.5Gbps Ethernet port, the TRB501 ensures that wired backhaul never becomes a bottleneck for the blazing-fast cellular speeds. This makes it an ideal choice for data-intensive environments such as high-resolution security surveillance, complex POS systems, and smart grid infrastructure. The integration of 4x4 MIMO technology further enhances signal stability and throughput, providing a robust wireless backbone for industrial IoT (IIoT) deployments that require maximum reliability. Compact and energy-efficient, this gateway is engineered for the most demanding environments, featuring a rugged aluminium housing and an impressive operating temperature range of -40°C to +75°C. The device supports a wide array of industrial protocols including Modbus, DNP3, and DLMS, allowing for seamless integration into existing SCADA systems and utility networks. With its small footprint, the TRB501 can be easily installed in limited spaces without sacrificing performance or durability. Security is paramount in industrial settings, and the TRB501 delivers with a comprehensive suite of features including advanced VPN support (OpenVPN, IPsec, WireGuard), a robust firewall, and remote management capabilities via the Teltonika RMS. Whether you are managing a fleet of remote devices or securing a single critical point of failure, this gateway provides the flexibility and protection needed for modern industrial operations. The inclusion of a 9W power supply and multiple mounting options ensures it is ready for immediate deployment straight out of the box. FEATURES Next-generation 5G connectivity with 3GPP Release 16 technology High-speed 2.5Gbps Ethernet port for massive data throughput Backward compatible with 4G LTE Cat 20 and 3G networks Supports 4x4 MIMO for superior signal reception and stability Industrial protocol support including Modbus, DNP3, and DLMS Rugged aluminium housing with IP30 ingress protection Ultra-wide operating temperature range from -40°C to +75°C Advanced security suite with multiple VPN protocols and firewall Compact form factor for easy installation in constrained spaces Flexible power options including 9-30VDC and Passive PoE SPECIFICATIONS Mobile Module: 5G Sub-6GHz SA/NSA; 4G LTE Cat 20; 3G Maximum Cellular Speeds: 5G: Up to 3.4Gbps DL, 900Mbps UL; 4G: Up to 1.6Gbps DL, 200Mbps UL Ethernet: 1x RJ45 port (10/100/1000/2500Mbps) CPU: ARM Cortex-A7, 1.5GHz, single-core Memory: 512MB RAM, 512MB Flash SIM Slot: 1x Mini-SIM (2FF) USB: 1x Micro USB for virtual NIC and configuration Digital I/O: 1x 4-pin socket (2x Configurable Digital Inputs/Outputs) Antenna Connectors: 4x SMA for Mobile Input Voltage: 9-30VDC (4-pin industrial socket) Power Consumption: Idle: Operating Temperature: -40°C to +75°C Enclosure: Anodised aluminium Dimensions: 100x30x93.4mm Weight: 241g WARRANTY 1-Year Limited Warranty

name: Heavy Duty Storage Shelving 2000H x 900W x 300D Extension Kit
description: Heavy Duty Storage Shelving 2000H x 900W x 300D Extension Kit
longDescription: Optimise your workspace footprint with our premium V2 industrial-grade heavy-duty storage shelving extension kit, engineered to seamlessly expand your customised configuration. Ideal for garages, warehouses, retail shops, and industrial environments, this modular add-on unit connects directly to an existing starter bay to effortlessly organise everything from automotive spare parts and hardware to bulk commercial inventory and general purpose archives. Designed as an extendable frame layout, it delivers a clean, secure, and highly professional custom storage setup for commercial premises and home garages alike. Engineered for high-capacity performance, this robust four-shelf single extension bay provides a safe environment for your heavy-duty storage requirements. Each individual shelf is constructed to comfortably hold an equally distributed weight of 200kg, accumulating to a massive total weight capacity of 800kg. To completely eliminate weak points and prevent bowing under pressure, the metal panels are manufactured with integrated back supports. For absolute structural integrity, a heavy-duty click-in system is reinforced with locking nuts and bolts that keep the frame securely aligned, providing rock-solid stability even when configuring or handling your setup. This unit is supplied specifically as an extension kit containing one upright frame, four adjustable shelves, and horizontal beams measuring 900mm wide from outer edge to outer edge. If you plan to expand your layout by linking multiple extension kits, subsequent bays connect by sharing a common upright frame rather than standing side-by-side. Because sharing a common frame saves you 80mm of wall space per additional bay, adding this kit increases your total system width by exactly 820mm. For example, a two-bay setup (one starter and one extension) measures 1720mm total width, while a three-bay setup measures 2540mm total width, allowing you to plan your floor layout with absolute precision. Please note that if you are integrating these upgraded V2 horizontal beams with V1 upright frames, custom pins are required for an optimal fit and can be requested directly from us upon order. Features New V2 upgraded heavy-duty structure featuring an increased metal thickness of 0.8mm. Premium laser-printed brand logo detailing for an authentic, high-quality finish. Fully adjustable shelf heights to seamlessly accommodate items of varying sizes. Adaptive V2 architecture with custom pins available on request for V1 upright frames. Modular expansion layout engineered to save 80mm of wall space per connected extension bay. Click-in system integrated with nuts and bolts for maximum stability and extra security. Smart interlocking profile adds exactly 820mm of linear workspace width per connected kit. Industrial powder coated finish for long-lasting protection against scratches and wear. Specifications Item Height: 2000mm Item Width (Beam Length): 900mm Added Width (Shared Upright Math): Adds 820mm to overall configuration width Item Depth: 300mm Shelf Quantity: 4 Per Shelf Capacity: 200kg (Equally Distributed) Total Load Capacity: 800kg Material Thickness: Upgraded V2 0.8mm Finish: Powder coated heavy-duty metal Warranty 2-Year Warranty
